arxiv-1611-06355.creator: Guim Perarnau, Joost van de Weijer, Bogdan Raducanu, Jose M. Álvarez
arxiv-1611-06355.description: Abstract Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) have recently demonstrated to successfully approximate complex data distributions. A relevant extension of this model is conditional GANs (cGANs), where the introduction of external information allows to determine specific representations of the generated images. In this work, we evaluate encoders to inverse the mapping of a cGAN, i.e.

arxiv-2109-14025.title: Deep Unrolled Recovery in Sparse Biological Imaging
arxiv-2109-14025.creator: Yair Ben Sahel, John P. Bryan *, Brian Cleary, Samouil L. Farhi, Yonina C. Eldar
arxiv-2109-14025.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Yair Ben Sahel, John P. Bryan *, Brian Cleary, Samouil L. Farhi, Yonina C. Eldar. Deep algorithm unrolling has emerged as a powerful model-based approach to develop deep architectures that combine the interpretability of iterative algorithms with the performance gains of supervised deep learning, especially in cases of sparse optimization. This framework is well-suited to applications in biological imaging, where physics-based models exist to describe the measurement process and the information to be recovered is often highly structured.

arxiv-2110-06037.title: SoftNeuro: Fast Deep Inference using Multi-platform Optimization
arxiv-2110-06037.creator: Masaki Hilaga, Yasuhiro Kuroda, Hitoshi Matsuo, Tatsuya Kawaguchi, Gabriel Ogawa, Hiroshi Miyake and Yusuke Kozawa
arxiv-2110-06037.description: Abstract Faster inference of deep learning models is highly demanded on edge devices and even servers, for both financial and environmental reasons. To address this issue, we propose SoftNeuro , a novel, high-performance inference framework with efficient performance tuning. The key idea is to separate algorithmic routines from network layers.

arxiv-2112-12302.title: Coherent reaction between molecular and atomic Bose-Einstein condensates: integrable model
arxiv-2112-12302.creator: Rajesh K. Malla, Vladimir Y. Chernyak, Chen Sun, Nikolai A. Sinitsyn
arxiv-2112-12302.description: Abstract We solve a model that describes a stimulated conversion between ultracold bosonic atoms and molecules. The reaction is triggered by a linearly time-dependent transition throughout the Feshbach resonance. Our solution predicts a nonexponential dependence, with a dynamic phase transition, of the reaction efficiency on the transition rate.

arxiv-2201-08386.title: 超対称性ゲージ理論のクーロン枝の数学的定義と Kac-Moodyリー環の幾何学的佐武対応
arxiv-2201-08386.creator: 中島 啓
arxiv-2201-08386.description: Abstract はじめに 筆者とBraverman，Finkelbergは， クーロン枝 (Coulomb branch) とよば れる新しい代数多様体のクラスと，その非可換変形(量子化)を導入し た [ Nak16a , BFN18 ] ． この研究は，もともと理論物理学の超対称性ゲージ理論において研究されてい たクーロン枝に，数学的に厳密な定義を与える，という動機に基づいている． そこで得た定義は，ホモロジー群の合成積を用いた代数の構成という手法によ る．これは幾何学的表現論で用いられてきた手法である．表現論と関連した 多様体の新しいクラスとして，クーロン枝は物理との関係を抜きにしても，純 粋に数学的な対象としてもおもしろいものである． [ BFN19a ] において，箙ゲージ理論と呼ばれるゲージ 理論のクーロン枝の，さらにそのホモロジー(正確には交叉コホモロジー)を考 えることにより，Kac-Moodyリー環の表現が構成されると予想した． これは，Kac-Moodyリー環が有限次元の複素単純リー環の場合には，クーロン枝 とアファイン・グラスマンとの関係 [ BFN19a ] を使うと， 幾何学的佐武対応とよばれている構成に他ならない．幾何学的佐武対応が， アファイン・リー環に拡張されることは Braverman-Finkelberg [ BF10 ] により予想されていた が， [ BFN19a ] の予想は，これをさらにKac-Moodyリー環に拡 張するものである．この論説の執筆時点で， A 型のアファイン・リー環の場合 に，予想の証明が与えられている [ Nakar ] ． 一方，この予想は，箙多様体のホモロジー群の上にKac-Moodyリー環の表現を構 成した筆者の研究 [ Nak94 , Nak98 ]

arxiv-2304-10970.title: Can GPT-4 Perform Neural Architecture Search?
arxiv-2304-10970.creator: Mingkai Zheng, Xiu Su, Shan You, Fei Wang, Chen Qian, Chang Xu, Samuel Albanie
arxiv-2304-10970.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Mingkai Zheng, Xiu Su, Shan You, Fei Wang, Chen Qian, Chang Xu, Samuel Albanie. We investigate the potential of GPT-4 [ 52 ] to perform Neural Architecture Search (NAS)—the task of designing effective neural architectures. Our proposed approach, G PT-4 E nhanced N eural arch I tect U re S earch (GENIUS), leverages the generative capabilities of GPT-4 as a black-box optimiser to quickly navigate the architecture search space, pinpoint promising candidates, and iteratively refine these candidates to improve performance.

arxiv-2306-15184.title: Determination of geopotential by hydrogen masers based on global navigation satellite system
arxiv-2306-15184.description: Abstract . According to the general relativity theory, a clock runs faster at a position with higher geopotential. Thus, the geopotential difference can be determined by comparing the clock’s vibration frequencies. Here we report on the experiments to determine the geopotential difference between two remote sites based on precise point positioning time-frequency transfer technique.

arxiv-2402-05740.title: CounterCLR: Counterfactual Contrastive Learning with Non-random Missing Data in Recommendation Thanks: This work was done when Jun Wang (jwangfx@connect.ust.hk) was a research intern at Kuaishou Technology Co., Ltd. Wenjia Wang (wenjiawang@ust.hk) is the corresponding author.
arxiv-2402-05740.creator: Jun Wang 1 , Haoxuan Li 2 , Chi Zhang 3 , Dongxu Liang 3 , Enyun Yu 3 , Wenwu Ou 3 , Wenjia Wang 1, 4
arxiv-2402-05740.description: Abstract Recommender systems are designed to learn user preferences from observed feedback and comprise many fundamental tasks, such as rating prediction and post-click conversion rate (pCVR) prediction. However, the observed feedback usually suffer from two issues: selection bias and data sparsity , where biased and insufficient feedback seriously degrade the performance of recommender systems in terms of accuracy and ranking.

arxiv-2403-01914.title: Linear Congruences in several variables with congruence restrictions Thanks: 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification: Primary 11D79, 11P83, 11A25, 11T55, 11T24. Keywords: System of congruence, Finite fields, Restricted linear congruences, Ramanujan sum, Discrete Fourier transform.
arxiv-2403-01914.creator: C. G. Karthick Babu, Ranjan Bera, B. Sury
arxiv-2403-01914.description: Abstract . In this article, we consider systems of linear congruences in several variables and obtain necessary and sufficient conditions as well as explicit expressions for the number of solutions subject to certain restriction conditions. These results are in terms of Ramanujan sums and generalize the results of Lehmer [ 7 ] and Bibak et al. [ 1 ] .

arxiv-2407-16059.title: Near-inertial echoes of ageostrophic instability in submesoscale filaments
arxiv-2407-16059.creator: Erin Atkinson 1, James C. McWilliams 2 and Nicolas Grisouard 1
arxiv-2407-16059.description: Abstract Ocean submesoscales, flows with characteristic size around 10 ​ m − 10 ​ km 10~\text{m}-10~\text{km} , are transitional between the larger, rotationally-constrained mesoscale and three-dimensional turbulence. In this paper we present simulations of a submesoscale ocean filament. In our case, the filament is strongly sheared in both vertical and cross-filament directions and is unstable.

arxiv-2408-10915.title: Neural Networks for Parameter Estimation in Geometrically Anisotropic Geostatistical Models
arxiv-2408-10915.creator: Alejandro Villazón, Alfredo Alegría, Xavier Emery
arxiv-2408-10915.description: Abstract This article presents a neural network approach for estimating the covariance function of spatial Gaussian random fields defined in a portion of the Euclidean plane. Our proposal builds upon recent contributions, expanding from the purely isotropic setting to encompass geometrically anisotropic correlation structures, i.e., random fields with correlation ranges that vary across different directions.

arxiv-2509-01126.title: Sensitivity-Driven Migration and the Evolution of Cooperation in Multi-Player Games on Structured Populations
arxiv-2509-01126.creator: Dhaker Kroumi
arxiv-2509-01126.description: Abstract Cooperation often depends on individuals avoiding exploitation and interacting preferentially with other cooperators. We explore how context-dependent migration influences the evolution of cooperation in spatially structured populations. Individuals interact in small groups through public goods games and reproduce with possible dispersal. Cooperators migrate more frequently when surrounded by defectors, while defectors disperse uniformly.

pmc-10542003.title: Clinical utility of prior positive cultures to optimize empiric antibiotic therapy selection: A cross-sectional analysis
pmc-10542003.creator: Rawand A Khasawneh, Basima A Almomani, Samah F Al‐Shatnawi, Lara Al-Natour
pmc-10542003.description: BackgroundDespite reduced infectious disease mortality and improved survival, infectious diseases continue to pose health threats due to their contagiousness, societal harm, and morbidity. Empiric antibiotic therapy, often prescribed without knowledge of the causative pathogen, faces challenges from rising antibiotic resistance. This study explores the potential of prior positive culture results to guide empiric antibiotic therapy.

pmc-10675237.title: Relationship between Serum Homocysteine Concentration and Dietary Factors in Young Japanese Women
pmc-10675237.creator: Akiko Tajima, Yoshinori Kubo, Sayaka Horiguchi, Kumiko Shoji, Terue Kawabata, Sara Baldassano
pmc-10675237.description: Homocysteine is a methionine metabolism intermediate and its increased blood levels are associated with a higher risk of noncommunicable diseases. Reportedly, blood homocysteine levels increase with inadequate folate, vitamin B6, and vitamin B12 intake; however, its relationship with dietary factors other than these three vitamins remains unknown. Thus, we investigated the relationship of homocysteine with other nutrient intake.

pmc-11643721.title: Cytoskeleton Remodeling-Related Proteins Represent a Specific Salivary Signature in PSC Patients
pmc-11643721.creator: Elisa Ceccherini, Antonio Morlando, Francesco Norelli, Barbara Coco, Massimo Bellini, Maurizia Rossana Brunetto, Antonella Cecchettini, Silvia Rocchiccioli, Vladimir N Uversky, C Michael Greenlief
pmc-11643721.description: Primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC) and Primary biliary cholangitis (PBC) are chronic inflammatory biliary diseases characterized by progressive damage of the bile ducts, resulting in hepatobiliary fibrosis and cirrhosis. Currently, specific biomarkers that allow to distinguish between PSC and PBC do not exist.

pmc-12659611.title: Impact of internal carotid artery thickness on postoperative cognitive function in cervical spondylotic myelopathy patients
pmc-12659611.creator: Huijuan Cao, PengXia Wang, Fan Yu, Jianmin Wang, Shanshan Liu
pmc-12659611.description: BackgroundCervical spondylotic myelopathy(CSM) is a prevalent degenerative disorder, with anterior cervical discectomy and decompression as the primary treatment. However, some patients may develop postoperative cognitive dysfunction (POCD). Carotid artery intima-media thickness (IMT), an early marker of carotid atherosclerosis, could be linked to changes in cerebral blood flow and cognitive function after surgery.

pmc-12717135.title: Text-mined dataset of solid-state syntheses with impurity phases using Large Language Model
pmc-12717135.creator: Sanghoon Lee, Kevin Cruse, Viktoriia Baibakova, Gerbrand Ceder, Anubhav Jain
pmc-12717135.description: Solid-state synthesis is widely used to obtain various inorganic materials, such as battery materials and bulk thermoelectrics. Despite its prevalence, the process remains challenging due to the lack of a general theory and well-understood underlying reaction mechanisms. While prior works have successfully extracted structured datasets from literature, they often neglect product phase purity or yield.

pmc-13078055.title: Complement role in kidney disease: a comprehensive review and therapeutic innovations
pmc-13078055.creator: Beatriz Cortez Ferreira, Gabriela Matos Silva, João Venda, Nuno Afonso, Rita Leal, Sofia Cerqueira, Ana Galvão, Helena Sá
pmc-13078055.description: The complement system is a vital component of innate immunity, known for its role in pathogen defense. It has been increasingly recognized as a mediator of homeostatic clearance, tissue repair, and immune-metabolic crosstalk. In the kidney, unique anatomical and hemodynamic features predispose to aberrant complement activation, rendering glomerular structures particularly vulnerable.

pmc-13178870.title: An exploratory study on cortical hemodynamics and handgrip strength phenotypes in long-term hospitalized patients with stable schizophrenia

pmc-13178870.description: ObjectiveThis exploratory study aims to investigate the relationship between handgrip strength (HGS) phenotypes and cortical hemodynamics in long-term hospitalized patients with stable schizophrenia, and to evaluate whether HGS could serve as a potential indicator of neurocognitive function in this population.MethodsIn this cross-sectional study, 96 patients with stable schizophrenia were enrolled. HGS was assessed using a calibrated dynamometer.

pmc-13388350.creator: Victor Fellipe Bispo Macedo, Alana Madeiro de Melo Barboza
pmc-13388350.description: BackgroundThe relationship between menopausal hormone therapy (HT) and Parkinson’s disease (PD) risk remains controversial, with inconsistent findings potentially driven by differences in hormonal formulations.MethodsWe conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis following PRISMA 2020 guidelines. MEDLINE/PubMed and EMBASE were searched between January 8 and March 14, 2026. Observational studies evaluating the association between menopausal HT and PD risk were included.

pmc-13496020.creator: Mohamed Farid, Mohamed A Elhorbity, Ashraf A Elsayed, Mostafa M Khairy, Mohamed Riad, Alaaedin Ramadan, Azza Baz, Nadia A Isaway
pmc-13496020.description: Introduction: Acute appendicitis is the most common abdominal surgical emergency worldwide, with peak incidence between the second and third decades of life. Appendectomy, performed for over a century, remains the standard treatment.Aim : We aimed to compare the safety and efficacy of laparoscopic appendectomy using the LigaSure system vs UltraCision harmonic scalpel (HS).

pmc-13552089.title: Surgical Treatment for the Ossification of the Coracoclavicular Ligaments: A Case Series of Four Patients
pmc-13552089.creator: Borg Leijtens, Luc Dirk Pieter Tilman, Marieke Ostendorf, Frederik Okke Lambers Heerspink, Oscar Dorrestijn
pmc-13552089.description: Introduction:Ossification of the coracoclavicular ligaments is a rarely described diagnosis that impairs shoulder functioning, and the best choice of treatment is unknown. In this article, four patients are described undergoing the surgical removal of this ossification. In three cases, the additional reconstruction of the ligaments is performed.Case Series:The patients were retrospectively enrolled, and the patient-related outcome measures were recorded.

zoist-vol-03-1845.creator: John Elliotson (editor)
zoist-vol-03-1845.description: Vol. III of The Zoist (1843–1856), the first and most important English journal devoted to mesmerism and cerebral physiology, founded by John Elliotson. Thirteen volumes form the movement's complete primary record: surgical cases, somnambulist reports, and the mesmerism-to-hypnotism debate.
